title: GuidanceRequest
description: A destination the MCP server asks the RuneLite plugin to guide the player to, written to guidance/request.json inside the snapshot directory. The server is the only writer; deleting the file withdraws the guidance. The plugin ignores requests older than a few minutes. Bump schemaVersion on any breaking change.

label.description: Human-readable name of the destination, shown to the player in the game chat.
